dish.title: Indonesian Gado-Gado with Pan-Fried Tempeh, Eggs, and Peanut Sauce
dish.description: A composed plate of boiled potatoes, green beans, cabbage, bean sprouts, cucumber, hard-cooked eggs, and golden pan-fried tempeh, spooned with a warm sweet-spicy peanut sauce of peanut butter, garlic, red chile, tamarind, soy sauce, brown sugar, and lime.

recipe_version.title: Indonesian Gado-Gado with Pan-Fried Tempeh, Eggs, and Peanut Sauce
recipe_version.description: A composed plate of boiled potatoes, green beans, cabbage, bean sprouts, cucumber, hard-cooked eggs, and golden pan-fried tempeh, spooned with a warm sweet-spicy peanut sauce of peanut butter, garlic, red chile, tamarind, soy sauce, brown sugar, and lime.

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.note: for the potatoes, eggs, and vegetables

ingredients.name: natural peanut butter
ingredients.display_name: natural peanut butter whose label lists only peanuts and salt

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Peel and cube the potatoes. Trim and halve the green beans, shred the cabbage, rinse the sprouts, and slice the cucumber. Cut the tempeh into 1/4-inch slabs. Mince the garlic, seed and mince the chile, and juice the lime.

steps.title: Boil the potatoes and eggs
steps.body: Put the potatoes, 8 cups water, and 1 tsp salt in a 4-quart pot, cover, and bring to a boil over high, about 10 minutes to come to a boil. Uncover, lower in the eggs with a slotted spoon, and simmer 10 minutes, until the potatoes are knife-tender and the eggs are hard-cooked. Steps 3 and 4 are done during this step (overlap stated).

steps.title: Pan-fry the tempeh
steps.body: While the pot heats: heat the oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high, add the tempeh in one layer, sprinkle with 1/4 tsp salt, and pan-fry until golden, 4 minutes per side. Drain on a towel-lined plate. Done inside step 2 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Make the peanut sauce
steps.body: While the eggs simmer: in a 2-quart saucepan over medium-low whisk the peanut butter, 3/4 cup water, soy sauce, brown sugar, tamarind, garlic, and chile until smooth and warm, about 4 minutes. Off the heat stir in the lime juice. Done inside step 2 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Blanch the vegetables
steps.body: Lift the eggs into a bowl under the cold tap and the potatoes onto a plate with the slotted spoon. Return the pot to a boil, about 1 minute, add the green beans for 3 minutes, the cabbage for the last 1 minute, and the sprouts for the last 30 seconds. Drain in the colander.

steps.title: Plate
steps.body: Peel and halve the eggs. Arrange the potatoes, green beans, cabbage, sprouts, cucumber, tempeh, and eggs on plates and spoon the warm peanut sauce over the middle.

coverage_contribution: Indonesia has no meal in the catalog. Tempeh goes from one lead (a ginger-glazed plate) to two. A warm composed vegetable plate with a peanut sauce for vegetarians; most vegetarian dinners in the catalog are bowls, curries, or pastas.
near_duplicate_review: Compared with salade-nicoise-seared-tuna: no fish, olives, or vinaigrette; tempeh, cabbage, and sprouts under a warm peanut sauce. Compared with peanut-noodle-stir-fry: a composed plate of boiled vegetables, not noodles. Compared with ginger-glazed-tempeh-plate: tempeh pan-fried plain and served with peanut sauce, not glazed with ginger. Compared with malian-chicken-maafe: a cold-and-warm vegetable plate, not a peanut stew.
not_duplicate_of: Not satay; no skewers and no meat.
